title: Support for Family Members of Prison Inmates
what_it_is: Support for Family Members of Prison Inmates

sections.label: Yellow Ribbon Community Project support
sections.summary: SPS works with community partners and grassroots volunteers through the Yellow Ribbon Community Project to assist offenders' families with resources and vouchers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: To address these issues, the Singapore Prison Service (SPS) collaborates with community partners through various programmes to assist the families.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Newly admitted offenders are encouraged to participate in the Yellow Ribbon Community Project or YRCP in short.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This is a grassroots-led programme where trained grassroots volunteers visit the offenders' families, befriend them and link them up with existing community resources, such as Social Service Offices and Family Service Centres, if required.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Booster packs containing grocery vouchers are distributed annually to help the families with day-to-day expenses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: School-going children receive vouchers that they can use to purchase school items.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The YRCP has grown from eight participating grassroots divisions in 2010 to 89 divisions in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The number of trained YRCP grassroots volunteers has likewise multiplied, from 74 in 2010 to more than 1,200 in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These volunteers have, to date, reached out to more than 15,000 families.
